title: Bank Of India Rupay Select credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: The BOI RuPay Select Credit Card is a premium offering from Bank of India designed for users who want everyday rewards with added lifestyle privileges. It combines RuPay-specific benefits with useful domestic perks, especially for India-focused spends.

benefitRows.name: Amazon Prime
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail Amazon Prime membership,spend ₹1.5 lakh within 90 days of card issuance.|Receive an SMS/email with a redemption link from Bank of Baroda.|Log in using your registered mobile number, OTP, and card details.|Get your coupon code and redeem it on the Amazon Prime website.

benefitRows.name: bigbasket
benefitRows.offer: INR 200 discount voucher per month on bigbasket
